nodes.label: “Between code and poetry” is not one continuum: prompting combines semantic slack with consequence coupling.
The prompt string is not the operative unit; the prompt-event includes an addressable situation.
A prompt’s operative semantics may be distributed across the expression and a learned interpreter.
Class versus path breaks under counterexample; specification, realization, and judgment survive.
Prompt-mediated writing places authorial intervention on both sides of realization.
Prompt receipts record causal lineage, not authorship; their stronger object is decision leverage.
Description does not become operation; machinery makes description consequence-bearing.
Operative representation can be defined by whether interpretation changes a system’s reachable futures.
“Between code and poetry” decomposes into semantic slack and consequence coupling.
The model may complete the specification while realizing it.
A failed generation can function as negative specification by eliciting criteria that did not yet exist propositionally.
“Who wrote it?” compresses a production graph into a single attribution variable.
Prompt receipts may matter because they resist authorship compression rather than prove authorship.
Prompt programming already treated natural language as task location, so “prompt as specification” is too narrow.
“Prompt” names incompatible research objects; template prompting cannot stand in for situated prompting.
Negative specification requires tacit judgment, but tacit knowledge is not automatically machine-addressable.
The author is constructed by operations on texts, not merely compressed from a production graph.
A regenerable text may still fail to carry the theory required to modify it.
A prompt may be a resource for situated generation rather than a specification of a future artifact.
Consequence coupling is too coarse: words act only through conditions of felicity.
What looks like specification completion may instead be task location.
Deferred formalization predates LLMs; the deeper change may be the breadth of what can remain unspecified.
Negative specification can steer without ever becoming explicit specification.
The author label does not merely compress production; it changes how discourse exists and circulates.
Deferred formalization may be ordinary situated design; generative AI may change the economy of provisional moves.
